sasha: Heads-up — starting ~08:12 UTC we're seeing a sustained spike of 502/504s hitting hosted API for several customers. Metrics show edge error rate -> 18% for last 10m. sample trace: trace=abc123def. Not sure if this is auth or billing related yet.

support-bot: ALERT: edge-proxy (ingress) 5xx spike detected. Group: support. See dashboard: https://redwood.example.com/d/q/edge-5xx

ravi: Can you paste a sample request/response (headers + tiny body) and one trace ID? I want to check upstream response codes and whether it's a reset vs upstream 5xx.

sasha: trace=abc123def (attached). Example response headers from edge: \n  status: 502\n  x-edge-reason: upstream-reset\n  x-upstream-cluster: billing-svc\n  x-request-id: req-9c2a\nResponse body: "{\"error\":\"upstream error\"}"

morgan: Repro steps I ran locally (short):\n```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Billing-Account: acct_42" \
  https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Result: intermittent 502 with `upstream reset` after ~350ms. When I replay against billing-svc directly it returns 429 intermittently with body `rate_exceeded`.

kevin: Logs from envoy (edge) around req-9c2a: \n```
[2026-02-28T08:12:31Z] envoy error: upstream reset before response: connection reset by peer (errno=104) cluster=billing-svc host=10.2.5.9:443
[2026-02-28T08:12:32Z] envoy warning: no healthy upstream hosts for cluster billing-svc, returning 502
```
Looks like billing backend is flapping / throttling and envoy circuit-breaking -> immediate 502s.

ravi: That matches. Billing history shows a throttle event at 08:11:59 for us-east region (burst of validation calls). Two hypotheses: 1) billing service started rejecting (429) which our edge treated as hard fail and reset connections, 2) billing internal pool exhausted -> RSTs. Need to confirm if the edge is configured to treat 429 as retryable or not.

morgan: Quick mitigation idea: add a short timeout + retry policy for billing calls at edge (eg 500ms timeout, 1 retry with jitter) and treat 429 as 503 for backoff so envoy will fallback to cached price if available. Also roll a rate-limit increase for internal billing for 15m.\nI'll propose a patch to ingress config: \n```
clusters:\n  - name: billing-svc\n    circuit_breakers:\n      thresholds:\n        - max_connections: 500\n          max_pending_requests: 1000\n    retry_policy:\n      retry_on: connect-failure,refused-stream\n      num_retries: 1
    upstream_timeout: 500ms
```

kevin: Ops can push a soft rollback: flip edge routing for affected customers to the fallback pricing cache (feature flag) while billing team investigates. Also I'll add a temporary circuit-breaker increase so transient bursts don't immediately mark cluster unhealthy.

sasha: Sounds good. For ticketing: ravi, can you open a Sev-2 with billing team and include the trace + envoy logs + curl steps? Add affected customer IDs: acct_42, acct_77, acct_99. Mark region us-east as highest priority.

ravi: Opening Sev-2 now. Will include: trace=abc123def, logs snippet, and repro curl. Adding billing oncall and platform-ops. ETA for initial triage: 15m.

support-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-2109. Linked to this thread.

morgan: After patch, monitor p50/p95 latencies and 5xx rate; leaving a 30m window before reverting any changes.

kevin: I'll run `kubectl logs` and tail envoy metrics and share a Grafana panel once patch is live.

sasha: Thank you — keep updates here. If you have a mitigation PR, ping me for quick sign-off. :thumbsup:
